name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair. Family Night on Tuesday, March 24th from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

name: Multicultural Faire
description: The PTA is eager and excited to have different cultures from around the world at our Annual Multicultural Faire! We would love to see you there, hosting a Booth or do a Performance showcasing your culture. If you or someone you know, would like to perform for Los Alamitos MCF, please reach out to us. It's a great opportunity for our kids to get involved, learn, and even present what they've prepared.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding! ***Volunteers must be registered with the district and approved by Los Alamitos.***

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC)
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support! Perfect for gifting (or treating yourself!), a sweet addition to Easter baskets, and a thoughtful way to celebrate moms, teachers, and the special people in our lives. Every purchase directly supports our young musicians and helps keep our music program strong.
